headline: Approved City Arts and Culture 2026-2027 budget, plus $400 meal budget and $400 ballroom rental for Cultural District Air Collaborative Workshop.
summary: The commission approved its 2026-2027 budget and the July 1 meeting minutes. It also approved Cassandra Sims as the artist for a traffic box artwork at Stafford Ave. and Washington St.
decisions: Approved the July 1, 2026 regular meeting minutes, all in favor.
Approved the City Arts and Culture 2026-2027 Budget, all in favor.
Approved Cassandra Sims as the artist for the traffic box artwork at Stafford Ave. and Washington St., all in favor.
Approved a $400.00 meal budget for the Cultural District Air Collaborative Workshop, all in favor.
Approved renting the Ballroom at the New England Carousel Museum for the Cultural District Air Collaborative Workshop, for a total of $400.00, all in favor.

decision_evidence.quote: MOTION: Made by Commissioner Wynter to Approve the July 1, 2026, City Arts and Culture Regular Meeting Minutes. Seconded by Commissioner Crist, all in favor, motion carried.
MOTION: Made by Vice Chair Adams to Approve the City Arts and Culture 2026-2027 Budget. Seconded by Commissioner Crist, all in favor, motion carried.

MOTION: Made by Vice Chair Adams to Approve Cassandra Sims as the artist for the Traffic Box Artwork at the corner of Stafford Ave and Washington Street. Seconded by Commissioner Yancy; all in favor; motion carried.
MOTION: Made by Vice Chair Adams to approve the Cultural District Air Collaborative Workshop Meal Budget of $400.00. Seconded by Commissioner Yancy; all in favor; motion carried.

MOTION: Made by Vice Chair Adams to approve renting the Ballroom at the New England Carousel Museum to host the Cultural District Air Collaborative Workshop, for a total of $400.00. Seconded by Commissioner Crist; all in favor; motion carried.

plain_text:
City of Bristol 
Arts & Culture Commission 
 
INFORMATION TO ACCESS MEETING 
https://bristolct-gov.zoom.us/j/83837598503?pwd=7mmPQw4bSobMWVv0x40Niq9zNhCcqm.1 
 
of the Arts & Culture Commission 
August 5, 2026 - 6:00 PM 
 
Ladies and Gentlemen: 
 
The regular meeting was held on Wednesday, August 5, 2026, at 6:00 PM in Meeting Room 1-3 in City 
Hall, 111 North Main Street, Bristol, CT 06010. 
 
1. Call to Order 
Chair Walter Lewandoski called the meeting to order at 6:03 p.m. 
 a. Pledge of Allegiance 
 
 
 
 b. Attendance 
 Members Present: Chair Walter Lewandowski 
Vice Chair Andrea Adams 
Commissioner Julie Crist 
Commissioner Juliet Norton 
Commissioner Nigel Wynter 
Commissioner E. Brad Yancy 
Arts and Culture Supervisor Arianna 
Therriault 
  
Absent: Commissioner Maria Salice   
City Council Liaison Greg Hahn 
  
 
2. Approval of Minutes 
 
 a. Approve the July 1, 2026, City Arts and Culture Commission Regular Meeting 
Minutes
MOTION: Made by Commissioner Wynter to Approve the July 1, 2026, City Arts and 
Culture Regular Meeting Minutes. 
Seconded by Commissioner Crist, all in favor, motion carried.  
 
3. Public Participation 
Lynn Litwinczyk, of 124 Hopmeadow Road in Bristol, spoke to the commission about becoming 
a Dementia Friendly Community. Lynn is currently a Speech and Language Pathologist at 
Bristol Hospital and offered to hold an informational session for the City Arts and Culture 
Commission. The overall goal is to help those living with dementia, and their caregivers, to 
remain safe, respected and included within the community. Discussion followed. 
 
Victoria Biondi, Treasurer of the New England Carousel Museum's Museum Board, presented 
an update on the Laff in the Dark Event, and upcoming events at the museum. Discussion 
followed.  
4. Supervisor's Report 
 
 a. Supervisor's Report 
 Arts and Culture Supervisor Arianna Therriault presented the Supervisor's Report. 
Supervisor Therriault provided an update on the Arts and Culture Coordinator Position. 
Discussion followed.  
 
 b. Project Spreadsheet 
 Nothing to report. 
 
 c. Year to Date Financials 
 Arts and Culture Supervisor Arianna Therriault presented the year-to-date financials. 
Supervisor Therriault stated there were slight differences in the final numbers for fiscal 
year 2026. Discussion followed.  
 
5. Chairman's Report 
Chair Lewandoski presented the Chairman's Report. Chair Lewandoski provided updates on 
the Cultural District Map, the possibility that there may still be a Pocket Park, and speaking with 
the Arts and Culture Group in Summerville, MA about how they operate 
6. Old Business 
 
 a. Approve the City Arts and Culture 2026-2027 Budget 
 MOTION: Made by Vice Chair Adams to Approve the City Arts and Culture 2026-2027 
Budget.  
Seconded by Commissioner Crist, all in favor, motion carried.
b. Approve Cassandra Sims Traffic Box Artwork at Stafford Ave. and Washington 
St. 
 MOTION: Made by Vice Chair Adams to Approve Cassandra Sims as the artist for the 
Traffic Box Artwork at the corner of Stafford Ave and Washington Street. 
Seconded by Commissioner Yancy; all in favor; motion carried.  
 
 c. Approve the Joe Johnson and Chair Lewandoski's Traffic Box Artwork at Green 
Hills/ Pine Street 
 Chair Lewandoski presented the Joe Johnson and Chair Lewandoski Traffic Box Artwork 
at Green Hills and Pine Street. Chair Lewandoski will return to the next meeting with a 
design for the commission to review.  
 
 d. Poly Resin Heart Updated 
 Chair Lewandoski presented the Poly Resin Heart Update. It is about 2 weeks until the 
painting of the heart is complete. Discussion followed.  
 
 e. By Commissioners 
 Nothing to report. 
 
7. New Business 
 
 a. Mum Festival Application 
 Vice Chair Andrea Adams presented the Mum Festival Application. Vice Chair Adams 
stated that the commission would have from 11:00 a.m. - 12:00 p.m. to set up, and have 
their space from 12:00 p.m. - 6:00 p.m. Discussion followed.  
 
 b. Urban Garden Mural Proposal 
 Chair Lewandoski presented the Urban Garden Mural Proposal. Chair Lewandoski stated 
that it would be a tribute to the military and will be attending the next Veterans Council 
Meeting to get their opinion and approval to move forward. The estimated cost of the 
mural would be $4000.00 - $5000.00. Discussion followed. 
 
 c. Approval of the Cultural District Air Collaborative Workshop Meal Budget: 
$400.00 
 MOTION: Made by Vice Chair Adams to approve the Cultural District Air Collaborative 
Workshop Meal Budget of $400.00. 
Seconded by Commissioner Yancy; all in favor; motion carried.
MOTION: Made by Vice Chair Adams to approve renting the Ballroom at the New England 
Carousel Museum to host the Cultural District Air Collaborative Workshop, for a total of 
$400.00. 
Seconded by Commissioner Crist; all in favor; motion carried.  
  
 
 d. By Commissioners 
 Nothing to report. 
 
8. Reports and Committee Reports 
 
 a. City Council Liaison Report 
 Nothing to report.  
 
9. Adjournment 
MOTION: Made by Commissioner Crist to adjourn at 7:15 p.m. 
Seconded by Commissioner Yancy; all in favor; motion carried.  
  
Respectfully Submitted,  
Amaris Estrada 
Recording Secretary 
City Arts and Culture Commission
